value: PREFIX s:     <http://cambridgesemantics.com/ontologies/DataToolkit#> PREFIX rdf:   <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX owl:   <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> PREFIX anzo:  <http://openanzo.org/ontologies/2008/07/Anzo#> PREFIX zowl:  <http://openanzo.org/ontologies/2009/05/AnzoOwl#> PREFIX dc:    <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> PREFIX canon: <http://altair.com/ontologies/ZS_Movies_Canonical_Ontology#> # targetGraph is replaced with the Layers URI at runtime # usingSources is replaced with the URIs of the Layer's Sources at runtime  INSERT {     GRAPH ${targetGraph} {      ?movie a canon:Movie ;        canon:id ?film_id ;        canon:name ?title ;      .     ?movie_director a canon:Director, canon:Person ;       canon:name ?director ;       canon:Person.workedOn ?movie ;       .     } } ${usingSources}  WHERE {    # SERVICE Clause: Include the following service call when reading or inserting data.     SERVICE TOPDOWN <http://cambridgesemantics.com/services/DataToolkit>     {        ?data a s:HttpSource ;     s:url  "${db.7a1d0e952b3fb26fb366502d3dabc167.url} " ;         # Mapping variables         #?mapping_variable ( [  "binding " ] [ datatype ] [  "datetime_format " ] ) ;              ?film_id( "id " xsd:string);     ?title();     ?director();     ?release_date();    }   BIND(SHA1(?director) AS ?director_id)   BIND(IRI(CONCAT( "http://demo.movies.com/ghibli/ ",?film_id)) AS ?movie)   BIND(IRI(CONCAT( "http://demo.movies.com/ghibli/director/ ",?director_id)) AS ?movie_director) }
